author_semantic_review_scope: Four complete current local objects: A Q19/Q26 and B Q07/Q26. This is not an author semantic regrade of all250 responses.

b.question: When do Fire and Malfunction exhaustion end the game; what if the target Room already has that marker, and where do removed markers go? What happens to sleepers and Intruders when hull integrity is lost?
reader_requested_parts: When Fire-marker exhaustion ends the game.
When Malfunction-marker exhaustion ends the game.
What happens if a Room already has a Fire marker and another Fire placement is instructed.
What the summary says about attempting to place a second Malfunction marker in one Room.
What happens to sleepers and Intruders when hull integrity is lost/the ship explodes.
b.observed_answer: 1. There are 8 Fire markers; being instructed to place one when the pool is empty makes the ship explode and ends the game. 2. There are 8 Malfunction markers; being instructed to place one when the pool is empty makes the ship lose hull integrity and ends the game. 3. Fire is limited to 1 marker per Room; an extra Fire placement in a Room already containing Fire does nothing. 4. Malfunction is limited to 1 marker per Room, but the summary does not specify the outcome of an instruction to place another Malfunction in a Room that already has one. 5. Discarded markers return to their matching supply pools. 6. When the ship explodes or loses hull integrity, all Characters aboard, awake and hibernated, die, as does everything else aboard, including Intruders.
b.reader_evidence: 1–4. Marker rules state: “Fire markers: (1) a Character ending their round in a burning Room suffers 1 Light Wound (see Turn Structure); (2) each Event Phase, each Intruder in a burning Room suffers 1 Injury and immediately makes its usual Injury Effect check; (3) there are only 8 Fire markers — if instructed to place one when the pool is empty, the ship explodes and the game ends. Max 1 per Room (extra placements do nothing); discarded markers return to the pool.” They state: “Malfunction markers: (1) the Room's Action is unavailable (Searching still works); repair effects (Repair Action cards, Tools Item) can discard the marker; (2) only 8 exist — if instructed to place one when the pool is empty, the ship loses hull integrity and the game ends. Max 1 per Room.” 5. Discard routing states: “return a discarded marker to its matching supply pool.” 6. End-of-game rules state: “The Self-Destruct marker reaches the final red ("skull") space of its Track, OR you are instructed to place a 9th Fire marker, OR a 9th Malfunction marker — the ship explodes / loses hull integrity: ALL Characters on board (awake and hibernated) die, and everything else aboard dies too, including Intruders.” The Fire rule explicitly says extra placements do nothing, while the Malfunction rule only states “Max 1 per Room”; the outcome of an attempted duplicate Malfunction placement is not otherwise stated.
b.expected_answer: Eight of each; required new placement with no pool marker explodes/loses hull integrity, all aboard including sleepers/Intruders die. Existing same marker means nothing happens; max one per Room. Removed markers return to pools.
b.reason: Partial: the duplicate-Malfunction outcome is expressly left unresolved despite being asked. Maximum one is stated, but the response does not commit to the fixed-key no-op result. Other requested parts are resolved; no false affirmative rule is invented.
